verdict: Leads steady at 128, but cost per lead is creeping up and needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 128 leads at an average cost of $11.44 per lead, with all paid activity running through Meta. Week over week, leads dipped 8.82% while cost per lead rose 8.71%, meaning spend is recovering faster than leads are — an efficiency trend we're watching closely. At the same time, your Google Business Profile actions dropped 42.37% in the past week, including three consecutive days of zero activity, which points to a real pullback in organic search visibility, not just normal fluctuation. We're investigating the GBP drop and addressing the paid efficiency pressure now. Expect a clearer picture on both fronts by next week's report.
